name: @hunyed15/project-cockpit
description: Project cockpit for DeepSeek Harness: one read-only page that answers where the project stands, what blocks it, who is working in parallel, and the next step. Wires existing sources (trellis tasks, review ledger, sessions) instead of inventing new state; the independent Claude Code review engine ships inside and is one of those sources.
author: hunyed15
